description: Network gene panel for cell-specific CSCN graphs. Selected from NTC cells only (both conditions); target identities and the Fufa gene list are the only other inputs. A panel of size P is the forced genes followed by the top P - n_forced fill genes.

method.expression: log1p CP10k with whole-transcriptome total_counts (as scripts/aim1.py)
method.fill_universe: scoring genes (one per symbol, no PAR_Y) detected (count > 0) in >= fill_min_detection of NTC cells in each condition, excluding exclude_pattern and forced genes
method.dispersion: Seurat-style mean.var.plot standardization, computed on log1p CP10k with equal-frequency mean bins: per condition, d = log(variance / mean) over NTC cells; z-score of d within n_bins mean-quantile bins of the fill universe
method.ranking: mean of the two within-condition z ranks (1 = most dispersed); ties by mean z, then gene_id
method.low_detection_flag: forced gene detected in < forced_low_detection of NTC cells in both conditions; forced genes are kept regardless
